notes:
POC & eval context: mid-market product analytics platform; building an in-app conversational assistant + semantic search for power users.
- Quote from CTO on discovery call: "need predictable unit economics before committing to dedicated capacity".
- Core ask: start on Hosted API for speed-to-value, then transition to Dedicated if unit cost wins and latency tail improves.
- Key metrics they care about: median latency <350ms for chat, p95 <900ms during business hours, embeddings throughput 200 reqs/sec for nightly batch jobs, cost per 1M tokens <$250 (target).
- POC findings so far: batching (max_batch_size=16) cuts GPU utilization by ~18%; KV prefix caching applied to frequent prompts saved ~12% tokens on common flows. Quantization candidates identified: Llama2-70B-gn (q4f16) and opt-6.7b (int8) — need fidelity tests.
- Finance is sensitive: wants a 3-year cost comp including reserved Dedicated capacity vs Hosted consumption.
- Infra asks: VPC peering, private subnet egress, and ability to bring their KMS key for Dedicated.
- Procurement timeline: legal + procurement to review contract redlines after final pricing; estimated procurement lead time 6-8 weeks.
- Internal champions: Senior PM (Aisha Khan) and ML lead (Ravi Patel).
- Risk noted: heavy long-context sessions for power users may reduce batching benefits — need telemetry on sequence length distribution.
- Action items: run quantization fidelity eval on representative prompt set; prepare detailed token-cost model for hosted vs dedicated; confirm SAML test user creation date with their IdP team.
additional_comments: They liked Redwood's smart routing idea — can start with hosted and route high-value traffic to Dedicated later.
